author: Michael A. Ball
title: Lam Research ( LRCX ) has a brilliant future ahead. Since th
text:
Lam Research ( LRCX ) has a brilliant future ahead. Since the beginning of 2017, the company's share price has grown a remarkable 75% — and yes, research shows it can continue higher.
Several factors influenced our earnings model to show that the share price could appreciate a further 9% after Wednesday's earnings report (Jan 24, 2018, 2:00 PM PT).
The TTM revenue grew 51% the last reported quarter and rolled to 8.8bln TTM — a new record and incredible growth. 
LRCX Revenue (TTM) data by YCharts Lam Research has shown vast improvements in most areas investors care about, substantial EPS gains, margin expansion, and revenue growth have all led analysts to revise up estimates for 2018. 
Capital Return Program We remain committed to investing in sustainable growth and augmenting returns through the combination of share repurchases and growing our dividend over time. - Lam Research Corp
Lam Research announced a $2 billion buyback program . They also increased the dividend by 11%.
Both of these metrics alone will drive the stock higher. The company's outstanding performance and exceptional cash flow generation should allow future programs to advance more aggressively — or at least that is what we are betting on. 
A breakdown of the capital return program: 
$2bln in share repurchase (over 12–18 months). $324m extra in dividend payments. Total capital to be repaid: $2.3bln. Market Trends The great news is that sales trends in the semiconductor industry remain positive. In fact, revenue growth rates are increasing rapidly.
Growth in this sector has improved dramatically over the past six years, the average revenue growth rate year-on-year was just 2% , year-on-year growth rates for revenue are now — on average — over 15%. This is a tremendous shift and shows positive momentum for the sector.
LRCX Revenue (TTM) data by YCharts One of the more exciting growth areas is cloud computing, especially with the inevitability of IoT (Internet of Things). Data-intensive applications are driving incredibly strong demand, both in DRAM and NAND, more specifically for IoT devices.
We are still early on in the development stages of IoT, and already this area has shown robust growth, and indeed, is the way of the future.
It is one thing we can be almost positive of - the manufacturing of microchips and memory devices will be around for a very long time.
All the top users of microchips could go out of business in the future — if better products take their place.
Apple (NASDAQ: AAPL ) crippled Nokia (NYSE: NOK ), digital photography destroyed Kodak, and Netflix (NASDAQ: NFLX ) killed Blockbuster.
Technology always is aiming for something better, and something better always comes along, but that something will almost always involve the use of microprocessors. 
In 1983, the transistor capacity per chip was 130,000. Today - 19,200,000,000 per chip. Even though we are tremendously ahead when compared to just a few years back, the demand for more speed and memory will never go away. 

Source: Wikipedia 
Valuing Lam Research LRCX PE Ratio (TTM) data by YCharts You can see from the chart above Lam Research has been trading around 15X and 20X earnings. In the model below we use 17X as our multiple.
Most analysts are raising their price targets for Lam Research. This comes late. During Lam's last quarter (Q1-FY2018) the company gave guidance of:
Shipments: $2.600 billion ± $100 million Revenue: $2.550 billion ± $100 million Non-GAAP Gross Margin: 47.5% ± 1% Non-GAAP Operating Margin: 30.0% ± 1% Non-GAAP Earnings per Share: $3.65 ± $0.12 Below, see that Lam Research beats Wall Street — and their own guidance — regularly.

Source: Seeking Alpha 
Management gave swings of $100mil ( + / - ) on revenue guidance and upped the margin estimates to its highest quarter in years, both gross and operating. 


After modeling the data, it becomes clear that the stock will produce a 9% upside after earnings — if guidance numbers are inline and management does not issue lower projected guidance. With good guidance, the stock could rally higher once the numbers have been digested and models are updated.
The positive updating of models should lead to a flood of upgrades and will draw a good deal of attention to the stock.


Final note Lam Research should be considered for a long-term investment. The stock beats estimates regularly, and revenue is growing. The sector as a whole remains on a good growth trajectory.
EPS estimates are 14.16 for FY18 and 15.28 for FY19, much higher than today's 10.95 EPS.
Continued increases in the dividend and share buybacks will ultimately boost the share price in the future. The buyback program has been projected to last around 18 months and has a value of $2.3bln — 6.8% of the company's market cap.
